description: Remove an address and its coordinates from a contact, taking it off the map. The contact itself is kept. Use list_map_contacts to get the exact ADR and GEO values.

adr.description: The ADR value to remove, exactly as returned by list_map_contacts

geo.description: The GEO value to remove, exactly as returned by list_map_contacts

myMapId.description: ID of a custom map to scope the operation to; omit for the user's default map

name: delete_map_contact_address
title: Delete Map Contact Address
